title: 4 Linen Midi Dress Styles Compared: Which One Should You Buy?
excerpt: Square neck, V-neck, shirt collar or flutter sleeve? Compare 4 pure linen midi dress styles by fit, occasion and body shape – and find the one made for you.
body:
A linen midi dress is the easiest summer outfit there is – but which style suits you best? Here are our four pure linen midi dresses, compared side by side.

## Quick comparison

| Style | Neckline & sleeves | Best for | Flatters |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Square Neck Sundress](/products/white-linen-square-neck-button-front-midi-sundress/) | Square neck, wide straps | Beach, city summers, brunch | Shoulders and collarbones |
| [Sleeveless V-Neck](/products/white-linen-sleeveless-v-neck-button-front-pleated-midi-dress/) | V-neck, sleeveless, pleated skirt | Garden parties, summer weddings | Petite and curvy shapes |
| [Collar Button-Down](/products/white-linen-collar-button-down-midi-dress/) | Shirt collar, short sleeves, pockets | Office, travel, everyday | Tall and athletic shapes |
| [Flutter Sleeve](/products/white-linen-flutter-sleeve-button-front-midi-dress/) | Notch neck, flutter sleeves | Brunch, dates, holidays | Covers upper arms softly |

## Which linen dress for which body shape?

- **Petite:** the Sleeveless V-Neck – the V-line and pleats lengthen the body.
- **Curvy / pear:** the Sleeveless V-Neck or Flutter Sleeve – both draw attention up and flow over the hips.
- **Apple:** the Collar Button-Down – the straight placket and collar create a long, clean line.
- **Tall:** the Square Neck Sundress – it shows off the shoulders and the A-line skirt balances height.
- **Want arm coverage:** the Flutter Sleeve.

## What all four have in common

- Pure linen with a soft cotton lining – breathable and never see-through.
- A full front button placket.
- Midi length that works from day to evening.
- Sizes XS–3XL, plus free Custom Fit.
- Available in 7 colours from our Shade Card at the same price.

## Why pure linen?

Linen is made from the flax plant. It breathes, dries fast, and gets softer with every wash – which is why it is the go-to fabric for hot weather and holidays. Read more in our guide: [Linen vs Cotton Dresses](/blog/linen-vs-cotton-dresses-which-is-better-for-hot-weather/).

## Frequently asked questions

**Which linen dress is best for a summer wedding?**
The Sleeveless V-Neck with its pleated skirt looks the most dressy. Pair it with pearl earrings and block heels.

**Which linen dress is best for the office?**
The Collar Button-Down – add a blazer and loafers.

**Are these linen dresses lined?**
Yes, all four have a cotton lining.

**Can I get these dresses in another colour?**
Yes – choose from White, Ivory, Beige, Sage Green, Sky Blue, Blush Pink or Black on the Shade Card, same price.

**Do you ship linen dresses outside India?**
Yes. Free shipping with duties included to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia; delivery in 5–10 business days after dispatch.
